executable.description: Basename of the owner's argv[0] as /proc/<pid>/cmdline reports it; empty when unknown. A reader deletes a live pid's file only when this and the pid's current basename are both non-empty and differ (the pid was recycled).

ports.description: Every port the owner holds and has not released, each once. Every registry reader excludes them until the owner exits.

title: Bind registry registration
description: One process's registration in the wire-tools-ts cross-process bind registry: <registry>/<pid>.bind-config.json, written atomically under the registry lock. Protocol: docs/bind-registry/README.md.
